author: host parallel CLI execution worker
explanation: Direct visible-coordinate program. It finds solid rectangles on BG=palette[0] and pairs same-colour rectangles facing across a gap. The bridge is gap x shared span with one cell trimmed at each end, painted BR=palette[8] on background. Rival rules are {centred, overlap} x {trim_any, trim_same, span_any, span_same, none}. Every rule that reproduces all demos is kept, and the program answers only if all survivors agree on the full query. Otherwise it raises Undetermined. It also raises when nothing survives, and when a bridge is needed but no demo shows its colour. D4 selects nothing.

ambiguity.intrinsic: None found. All native labels equal centred/trim_any on the visible input, for every audited pair.
ambiguity.context_shortfall: Canonical fixture: overlap/* fits the train demos and differs on the test (canonical-fixture-counterexample-v7-f3b10344.json). Fresh episodes: contexts resampled with the query held fixed. See host-audit.json rejection_stats.

The v7 audit uses a 30 s deadline, then redraws and counts the misses (see rejection_stats). Dimensions are not restricted. Proposed host fix, not applied: redraw subset/expected_boxes after K failed geometry attempts. This needs a distribution review.
